Re: Foreign Patents on Cases 38 and 39

Gentlemen:

On June 26, 1978, Fabriques de Tabac Reunies S.A., an affiliate of Philip Morris Incorporated, purchased the entire right, title and interest to certain of Liggett Group Inc.'s (formerly Liggett & Myers Incorporated and Liggett & Myers Tobacco Company) patents and patent applications in all countries of the world except for the United States. The subject cases have been transferred to and are now the property of Fabriques de Tabac Reunies S.A.; therefore, all future correspondence concerning same should be sent to Watson Leavenworth Kelton & Taggart, 100 Park Avenue, 28th Floor, New York, New York 10017, Attention: George J. Brandt, Jr., Esq. All future instructions with respect to these cases will be received from Mr. Brandt. If you have any questions regarding the handling of this matter, please do not hesitate to contact me.

We would like to take this opportunity to express our gratitude for the excellent service that you have extended Liggett in the maintenance of its foreign patents and patent applications and look forward to working with you in the future.

Sincerely,
Original Signed by
J. Bowen Ross, Jr.
